title: Google Discussion forum
notes: Not checked: the text, image or video requirement does not apply to a post represented on another page through an external url.
SocialMediaPosting is accepted with the same requirements.
Post needs one of text, image or video; this is NOT required for a post represented on another page via external url (later pages / category pages).
Comment: author, datePublished and one of text/image/video required.

InteractionCounter: userInteractionCount required; interactionType is an Action subtype (post: LikeAction, DislikeAction, ViewAction, CommentAction or ReplyAction, ShareAction). creativeWorkStatus=Deleted for retained deleted posts. sharedContent may be WebPage, ImageObject, VideoObject, DiscussionForumPosting or Comment. url: canonical URL (first page for multi-page threads). headline not recommended for SocialMediaPosting.
If the forum is question-and-answer shaped use Q&A markup instead.
